Quick procurement perspective: SpectraMed's initial terms look standard but procurement often tries to negotiate exclusivity or preferred vendor language post-bakeoff. Two suggestions to reduce risk: 

1) Split the allocation into three tranches to discourage immediate stacking: 20k immediate / 20k after verified run / 10k on pilot signature (as Marissa suggested)
2) Require a short attestation checkbox in the MPA: "Buyer confirms the evaluation will include competing vendors and will provide raw run artifacts for verification" — that gives us a reasonable audit trail without heavy contract work

Note: finance prefers a PO for credits >= $10k equivalent but we can make an exception for strategic accounts if RevOps approves. If this is strategic, mark as "sales-approved exception" in HubSpot and we can fast-track.

Attached is a quick procurement-qa.pdf with the standard questions we send to buyers (data residency, PHI, expected call volume).
